history.caption: Boundary controls like circuit breakers and output gates act on the seams between agent steps to halt cascading errors.
history.title: Agentic-Boundary-Containment-Gate

style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly resting on a brushed steel surface. An asymmetric composition, hero off-centre on the right third with generous negative space on the left. Two interlocking machined aluminum routing bays, separated by a distinct physical inspection gate and a heavy brass quarantine latch. One pathway is seamlessly aligned, while the parallel channel is physically shuttered by the drop-gate. Hard clean edges, matte muted industrial palette with one amber accent on the latch. One strong directional key light raking across the modules, casting a long, deep shadow. Tactile material presence.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random letters, numbers, UI, watermarks, signature, illegible typography
rationale: The story is about a structural rule—a boundary gate and containment quarantine. A minimalist studio composition of an interlocking mechanical inspection gate captures this precise modular restraint without resorting to software cliches.
cue: set at the boundary between its steps
subject: an interlocking modular inspection gate with a physical circuit-breaker mechanism isolating one pathway
core_thesis: An agent's end-to-end reliability is determined at the boundary between steps, where failure compounds exponentially without physical containment controls.
core_conflict: Cascading systemic failure vs. rigorous boundary containment and isolation.
composition: asymmetric composition, hero off-centre on the right third
